deliverables.name: Latest passport-size photograph
deliverables.specification: JPG; 20-200 KB; exact filename 'photo.jpg'. Colour, recent, plain white background, frontal full face, head centred, both ears visible, eyes open, natural expression, at least 75% face coverage; no shadows, dark glasses, uniform or signed photograph.
deliverables.evidence_status: Current official UPSC common application instruction

deliverables.name: Live photograph
deliverables.specification: Captured during the UPSC application using the current device webcam or by scanning the displayed QR code and using a mobile device. Good lighting and clear face required. The live image is matched with the uploaded passport photograph; mismatch blocks further application.
deliverables.evidence_status: Current official UPSC common application instruction

deliverables.name: Triple-signature image
deliverables.specification: Sign three times vertically, one below another, on plain white paper using black ink. Scan all three signatures in one clear, correctly oriented image. JPG; filename 'signature.jpg'; 20-100 KB; published image dimension 350-500 pixels.
deliverables.evidence_status: Current official UPSC common application instruction

deliverables.name: Application declaration
deliverables.specification: Candidate confirms the correctness of the application before final submission. No separate uploaded declaration file was found in the common instruction.
deliverables.evidence_status: Portal step; exact wording varies by application

rejection_conditions: Shadows on the face or background are not accepted.
Non-frontal or side-facing pose can fail the stated requirement.
Eyes must be visible/open as stated.
Spectacle glare, dark or coloured glasses can make the photograph unacceptable.
Face coverage below 75%, blurred image, misaligned face, face too close/out of frame, or ear lobes not visible are explicit UPSC rejection examples.
A live-photo mismatch with the uploaded passport photograph prevents the candidate from proceeding.
A signature image that is not exactly three vertically arranged signatures, is blurred/dark, incorrectly oriented, or outside the published file specification is rejected.

deliverables.name: One-Time Registration identity input
deliverables.specification: Mobile number and email verified by OTP. Aadhaar authentication is available; where Aadhaar is not used, an accepted identity number/document route is required. Accepted identity-number alternatives listed by SSC include Voter ID, PAN, Passport, Driving Licence, School/College ID and Employer ID.
deliverables.evidence_status: Current official SSC CGL 2026 notice; family-level portal rule
deliverables.important_note: The exact non-Aadhaar document-upload flow should be checked on the active SSC OTR screen.

deliverables.name: Live candidate photograph
deliverables.specification: Captured through webcam/mobile/app; a pre-existing photograph must not be photographed. Use good light and plain background; camera at eye level; face fully within the guide; frontal view; no cap, mask or spectacles. Poor-quality, miniature, blurred or side-facing images may be rejected.
deliverables.evidence_status: Current official SSC CGL 2026 notice; SSC portal family rule

deliverables.name: Scanned candidate signature
deliverables.specification: JPEG/JPG; 10-20 KB. Current CGL notice gives about 6.0 cm x 2.0 cm in one section and 4.0 cm x 2.0 cm in its application annexure; this internal inconsistency is retained as conflicting. Blurred or miniature signatures are liable to rejection. PwD(VH) candidates may use thumb impression where the notice permits.
deliverables.evidence_status: Current official SSC CGL 2026 notice; conflicting dimensions

deliverables.name: Disability certificate
deliverables.applicability: PwBD/PwD candidates claiming reservation and/or scribe
deliverables.specification: Upload the applicable certificate in the prescribed annexure/form at the time of application. Exact PDF size/format was not found in the extracted notice text.

deliverables.name: Online declaration
deliverables.specification: Read and accept the declaration after reviewing the application details. Concealment, misrepresentation or misdeclaration can cancel candidature.

rejection_conditions: Non-frontal or side-facing pose can fail the stated requirement.
Spectacle glare, dark or coloured glasses can make the photograph unacceptable.
Caps/hats are restricted; any permitted religious covering must leave required facial features visible.
A face mask/covering is restricted according to the stated policy.
Capturing a photograph of a pre-existing printed/digital photograph is liable to rejection under the cited SSC notice.
Poor-quality, miniature, blurred or side-facing live photographs and blurred/miniature signatures are liable to rejection.
The current notice gives different signature widths in two sections; candidates should follow the live portal's validator.

deliverables.name: Candidate signature
deliverables.specification: JPG/JPEG; normally 10-20 KB; about 140 x 60 pixels; signature in black ink on white paper; signed by the applicant; not in capital letters.

deliverables.name: Left thumb impression
deliverables.specification: JPG/JPEG; normally 20-50 KB; about 240 x 240 pixels; applicant's left thumb impression on white paper using black or blue ink; clear and unsmudged.

deliverables.name: Handwritten declaration
deliverables.specification: JPG/JPEG; normally 50-100 KB; about 800 x 400 pixels; handwritten in English on white paper with black ink; not in capital letters. Standard wording: 'I, ______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.' Copy the exact live-portal wording.

deliverables.name: SSC/SSLC/Class 10 certificate
deliverables.specification: A scanned certificate is required in the current IBPS application family. It is used as documentary support for date of birth/identity particulars as specified in the notice. Exact upload size and format must be read from the active portal because they were not fully extracted here.

deliverables.name: Scribe eligibility certificate
deliverables.applicability: Candidates eligible for and claiming a scribe under the relevant clause
deliverables.specification: Upload the certificate in the prescribed format where the notice requires it. Do not upload for candidates not claiming the facility.

rejection_conditions: Shadows on the face or background are not accepted.
Non-frontal or side-facing pose can fail the stated requirement.
Eyes must be visible/open as stated.
Spectacle glare, dark or coloured glasses can make the photograph unacceptable.
Caps/hats are restricted; any permitted religious covering must leave required facial features visible.

Unclear photograph, signature, thumb impression or declaration can lead to rejection.
Signature or handwritten declaration in capital letters is not accepted in the cited banking-family instructions.
